prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1185; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a multi-lane road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the vehicle made a lane change to the left and contacted the left side of Driver 2's vehicle, which was traveling alongside in the adjacent lane. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy. Driver 1 and Driver 2 both remained at the scene and exchanged information. A passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision.

Witness statements, photographs taken at the scene, and Driver 2's account all agree with how the collision occurred. The damage visible on both vehicles is consistent with a sideswipe impact of this kind, and no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle has been identified by the parties or the reporting officer.

Driver 1 reported neck and back strain following the collision and requested medical attention. At the time of this report it cannot be determined whether these symptoms were caused by this crash. The seating position of Driver 1 at the moment of impact is also not fully established from the information gathered at the scene, and the passenger's position has not been confirmed. Follow-up with the involved parties is recommended to clarify these points.
